prow:
n. 船首, 船首状物
a. 勇敢的
n front part of a vessel or aircraft

prowess: n. 英勇, 勇敢, 超凡技术

vi. 潜行以觅食, 徘徊

n. the act of prowling (walking about in a stealthy manner)
v. move about in or as if in a predatory manner
prowled: v. 小心翼翼地移动( prowl的过去式和过去分词 ); 徘徊; （动物）潜行（为捕猎等）; 潜行（图谋不轨等）
prowler: n. someone who prowls or sneaks about; usually with unlawful intentions

v move about in or as if in a predatory manner
v loiter about, with no apparent aim
